finding.headline: "The Tongue-Tie Suspect Mama"
finding.problem: "The nurse said 'some babies struggle.' But my nipples are shredded and he's not gaining. What if it's his tongue and nobody's checking?"
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 24-yr-old mum, baby clicks, falls off, nipple looks pinched, weight slow; suspects tongue-tie but referral wait is weeks and husband says "he's just small."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (red-flag checklist) inside A1/A3 — "Tongue-Tie Red Flags: When to Push for a Referral (and what to do while you wait)."". Verdict: PASSES (18/25)..
